content: No mature, widely-adopted turnkey 'media regression diff for CI' product was found in the general search results as of 2026 — teams roll their own by wrapping ffmpeg calls in pytest/Mocha, hashing outputs (md5/sha256) for lossless byte-exact checks, and using SSIM/PSNR for lossy comparisons, then emitting JSON/JUnit for CI dashboards. This is evidence for a real gap mediadiff targets — the DIY pattern it replaces is real and documented, but no dedicated tool fills it yet at LOW-MEDIUM confidence (single search pass).
